Run INTERACT Signaling Detection

RunInteract.Rd

This function executes the core signaling pipeline for the INTERACT package, integrating genomic alterations, pathway activity, and phenotypic states.

Usage

RunInteract(
  nontumor.matrices,
  tumor.matrix = NULL,
  snv.matrix = NULL,
  cnv.matrix = NULL,
  program.gene.lists = NULL,
  n.cores = max(1, parallelly::availableCores() - 2),
  beta.pathways = 5,
  beta.programs = 8,
  scale.pathways = "auto",
  scale.programs = "auto",
  pathway.receptor.map = NULL,
  program.constraints = NULL,
  omni.network = NULL,
  min.expression = 1,
  calibrate.n.samples = 15,
  run.autoencoder = TRUE,
  conda.env = "pytorch",
  autoencoder.epochs = 150L
)

Arguments

nontumor.matrices

A named list of expression matrices (samples x features) for microenvironment cells.

tumor.matrix

Optional. A single expression matrix for the tumor cells.

snv.matrix

Optional. A numeric matrix (samples x features) of tumor somatic mutations (e.g., 1 = activating, -1 = repressive, 0 = WT). Continuous probabilities are also supported.

cnv.matrix

Optional. A matrix (samples x features) of tumor copy number alterations (absolute encoding, diploid = 2).

program.gene.lists

Data frame containing gene sets (ImmPort/Reactome).

n.cores

Integer. Number of cores for parallel processing.

beta.pathways

Numeric. Weighting factor for pathway activity. Default is 5.

beta.programs

Numeric. Weighting factor for phenotypic programs. Default is 8.

scale.pathways

Numeric or "auto". Automatically tuning denominator to bring raw PROGENy scores into roughly [-2, 2] range before squashing.

scale.programs

Numeric or "auto". Automatically tuning denominator to bring raw ssGSEA scores into roughly [-2, 2] range before squashing.

pathway.receptor.map

Optional custom mapping of pathways to receptors.

program.constraints

Optional data frame for lineage-specific program filtering.

omni.network

Optional OmniPath network data frame to bypass API download.

min.expression

Numeric. Minimum log-scale expression threshold for ligand or receptor subunits.

calibrate.n.samples

Integer. Number of random samples to profile during auto-calibration. Default is 15.

run.autoencoder

Logical. If TRUE, trains the multi-channel GNN Graph Autoencoder on the interaction network and extracts latent patient embeddings for downstream UMAP and Louvain clustering. Default is TRUE.

conda.env

String. Conda environment containing PyTorch and PyTorch Geometric for the autoencoder. Default is "pytorch".

autoencoder.epochs

Integer. Number of training epochs for the Graph Autoencoder. Default is 150.

Value

A list containing interactions, diagnostics, embeddings, precompute data, and topology metrics.

Details

Outputs a list of data frames:

  • interactions: A data frame of all scored cell-cell interactions. Key columns include source_genesymbol (ligand), target_genesymbol (receptor), sample, sender, receiver, base.score (raw expression product), weight.genomic (DNA alteration modifier), weight.pathways (PROGENy modifier), weight.programs (phenotypic modifier), and final.score (fully integrated score).

  • diagnostics: A list of summary data frames for auditing the pipeline. Includes input.signal (raw matrix summaries), weight.layers (global impact of weights), receiver.source and sender.source (evidence breakdown), weight.direction (net functional multiplier direction), rank.shift (rank changes after weighting), and genomic.hits (genomically boosted interactions).

  • topology.metrics: A list of network metrics calculated per sample. Includes node (centrality and signaling roles per cell type), edge (communication weights between populations), and graph (ecosystem-wide density and transitivity).

  • Additional Outputs: precompute (data for Shiny app), modality.progeny.scores (raw pathway scores), functional.program.scores (raw program scores), and program.gene.lists (reference gene lists).
